column1: Note 1:OCNG shall be used such that the resources in cell # 1 are fully allocated and a constant total transmitted power spectral density is achieved for all OFDM symbols.Note 2:The uplink resources for CQI reporting are assigned to the UE prior to the start of time period T1.Note 3:The timers and layer 3 filtering related parameters are configured prior to the start of time period T1.Note 4:The signal contains MPDCCH for UEs other than the device under test as part of OCNG.Note 5:SNR levels correspond to the signal to noise ratio over the cell-specific reference signal REs.Note 6:The SNR in time periods T1, T2 and T3 is denoted as SNR1, SNR2 and SNR3 respectively in figure A.7.3.76.1-1.Note 7:For 4 Rx UE, SNR in T3 is -17.2 dB.
